name: Fujishiro Mei
source:
"[url=/c115546]Akane-chan[/url], please stay out of this! Because you're still young!"

Although she had difficulties when she was auditioning, after many efforts, she is now an idol belonging to an agency.

Her serious personality made it difficult for her to get noticed in the entertainment industry. However, she has confident in her proportions, and knows how to show them off. As a gravure idol, she has a fanbase, but is not well-known.

Due to her being difficult to work with, her agency is abandoning her which made her become desperate for works because she is approaching her 30s.

Since she is also taking good care of her kouhai, she is well-liked by them. However, due to her strong sense of justice, she is being shunned by her superiors.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/namahaishin/#chara]Official website[/url]]
